assumptions.choice: Support is the 20-bar minimum Low and resistance is the 20-bar maximum High.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not identify which OHLC field defines the 20-bar minimum and maximum.

assumptions.choice: Win rate uses the last 100 closed Backtrader trades and counts a trade as a win when net PnL after commission is positive; entries are disabled until 100 closed trades exist.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define win/loss accounting or behavior before 100 trades are available.

assumptions.choice: Each completed entry order is one unit; up to three units may be open concurrently, each with its own ATR-derived target and stop.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly permits up to three open units while separately defining an entry size.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit and stop-loss are native limit and stop orders placed after entry fills, using the actual fill price and ATR value at that fill.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives price levels but does not state whether they trigger intrabar, at close, or from signal-bar values.
